note: In Paar oder Koalition bleibst du der Löwe der Trockengebiete. Allein beschreibt das Profil einen Einzelgänger fürs Leben, der nur Artgenossen bekämpft, lautlos aus der Deckung pirscht, kein Aas frisst und sich höchstens ein paar Tage zusammentut. Das ist der Puma, der Rotluchs bleibt für Nacht und Höhle.

analogs.covers: Solo life: a lifelong loner that fights only its own kind, stalks big prey from cover, eats only its own kills and meets others just briefly to mate
Night routine: a nocturnal stalker that sleeps in caves and overhangs by day and curiously shadows other animals

solo.headline: A lone cougar of the dry country: a silent night stalker that tolerates every other species, drives out its own kind and hides in caves by day.
solo.playsLike: Alone you hunt up to Large tier, at night only. Young Apatosaurus and Amargasaurus come first, but you need not take guarded or Adolescent Apatosaurus; next you try to surprise stegosaurids. You go silent, crouch low behind foliage and rocks and pick a lone or sleeping target. Every other species is tolerated and you may follow it out of curiosity, but any other Allosaurus in the POI must be challenged out before you hunt or nest. You do not scavenge. If you fail to bring down large prey for days or want to nest, you may team up for a few days, then leave again without a goodbye. As a solitary male you may leave the family once the clutch has succeeded.

why.text: Many Allosaurus “opt to remain solitary, sometimes for the entirety of their life” and “do not find any difficulty in surviving alone”. Adult cougars live alone too.
Loners team up only for big prey or a nest, “typically only lasting a few days”, and leave “often without even a goodbye”. Cougars meet for a few days to mate and part again.

“Allosaurus have an aggressive nature towards other Allosaurus, but are tolerant towards other species.” Male cougars fight other cougars for territory, often to the death, and give way to other predators.
On prey it will “grow silent, crouching low to the ground, and tucking themselves behind foliage and rocks”, looking for an animal that is alone or sleeping. That is the cougar's stalk-and-pounce.
“Allosaurus are not scavengers.” Cougars rarely scavenge and live almost entirely on what they kill themselves.

A solitary male “may choose to abandon their family” after a successful clutch, the mother raises the cubs in a den, and siblings often leave as “a dispersal group that leaves together”. Cougar fathers give no care, and young cougars disperse with their siblings.

notLike: Cougars kill with a bite to the neck or throat; Allosaurus prefers to bleed its prey out.
Cougars hold their range year-round; a solo Allosaurus only claims a POI when it wants to hunt or nest there.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein Puma der Trockengebiete: ein Einzelgänger, oft fürs ganze Leben, der gut allein zurechtkommt. Du jagst nur nachts und bis Large, zuerst junge Apatosaurus und Amargasaurus, wobei du bewachte oder halbstarke Apatosaurus auslassen darfst, danach versuchst du Stegosaurier zu überraschen. Auf der Pirsch wirst du still, duckst dich hinter Büsche und Felsen und suchst dir ein einzelnes oder schlafendes Tier. Andere Arten duldest du und folgst ihnen manchmal neugierig, aber jeden anderen Allosaurus im POI forderst du heraus, bevor du jagst oder nistest. Aas frisst du nicht. Klappt die große Beute tagelang nicht oder willst du nisten, tust du dich für ein paar Tage mit anderen zusammen und ziehst danach ohne Abschied weiter. Tagsüber schläfst du versteckt in Höhlen, unter Überhängen oder im Dickicht.
